description: Replaces the css2/ stylesheet set. Eight shared CSS files (one @layer cascade) plus two per-site files. No design system beyond tokens, typography, boilerplate fixes and section skeleton — everything else is a guide doc, not a CSS recipe. See README.md for the full contract.
cdnRootStatus: NOT YET DEPLOYED — no write access to this host from any tool in this repo. See 'testDeployment' below for the working substitute in use right now.

shared.name: vendor.css
shared.optional: Drop on a site with no DOCman/FILEman.

shared.name: features.css
shared.optional: Drop on a site with no alert/bulletin/ads/sponsorship.

perSite.name: site-tokens.css
perSite.note: Unlayered on purpose — must win over kit.tokens regardless of specificity. The only file a build edits for brand.
perSite.alsoLoadedBy: front end (Base outline CSS asset row, priority 2) and the editor (imported by /content/editor.css)
perSite.templateNote: Repo copy currently holds shannon.forge's real brand values (navy/goldenrod/ivory taupe, EB Garamond/Lato) as a worked example, not placeholder values. A new clone must overwrite section 1 with its own brand before use.

perSite.name: editor.css
perSite.note: Declares no design values. TinyMCE chrome only — .mce-content-body padding/max-width, table-wrapper re-asserts, empty-block placeholders, the Read More divider.
perSite.wiredVia: Joomla > Plugins > Editor - TinyMCE > Custom CSS Classes (comma-separated list, no spaces after commas)

editorCustomCssClassesNote: Layer 5 (/images/pub/editor.css) is the custom-page agent's per-page scratch space. It is normally absent on a fresh clone — a 404 there costs nothing — so do not point it at anything else.

baseOutlineAssetRows.note: Add the 8 shared files at priority 1, site-tokens.css at priority 2, then the site's own override.css last. Only vendor.css and features.css are optional.

openQuestions.status: Still linked on the Base outline test wiring — not superseded by anything in the kit.
openQuestions.detail: Two unrelated things in one file: (1) a `.grid-articles` / `.grid-title-style-N-color` (40 combos) / `.grid-sideways` / `.grid-circle-image` / `.grid-hexagons` named-variant library for the Joomla-Articles-particle grid — same category-1 shape as the already-dropped headlines.2.0.css and slideshow.2.0.css, and its class names do not even match kb/grid-layout's own documented example classes (grid-tiles/grid-square/grid-tiles-mobile), suggesting it may already be dead weight. (2) a `.fancy-galleries #fileman-folders` FILEman gallery-grid treatment, a second look alongside vendor.css's existing `.gallerycolorstrip` pattern for the same feature. Recommendation: likely safe to drop part 1 (superseded by the same guide-doc approach as headlines/slideshow); part 2 needs a decision on whether `.fancy-galleries` is still an active look on any real site before dropping it.

openQuestions.status: RESOLVED 2026-08-28 — unlinked from the Base outline test wiring. features.css's port is confirmed sufficient on its own.
openQuestions.detail: Restored the required route (/sponsors-list/sponsor-this-site, per kb/business-directory — the menu item had been removed in the earlier demo cleanup) specifically to run this test. Screenshotted the live page (desktop + mobile) with sponsorship2.css linked, unlinked it, screenshotted again: pricing tiers, FAQ grid, sidebar suppression, and the FontAwesome nav-icon fix all rendered identically. Also line-by-line diffed the original CDN file's rules against features.css's :is()-consolidated port — full coverage, nothing missed. sponsorship2.css is no longer linked on the Base outline.
